_about: One chart input (CAM 1, the total_panel column of pcb_sensata) as the workflow node stores it (conf, data.series.s1) and as the compiled widget row stores it (rows, after builder.validate). tests/smoke_seriesedits.py checks the real compile produces exactly these rows for an area, line, spline and bar chart; tests/check_seriessync.mjs renders the node's Inputs row from conf and the Builder's series row from rows and checks both panels show the same answers.
